problem_statement: When a Border Router is delegated a DHCPv6-PD prefix and an on-link router simultaneously advertises a default route, the routing policy is not re-evaluated whenever the favored OMR prefix changes. As a result, the default-route flag on the OMR prefix in Network Data and the published external route do not track the AIL default route state: the published route stays a ULA route (and the OMR prefix without a default-route flag) even while a default route is being advertised, and when the PD prefix later expires while a fresh AIL default route is still active the published route and OMR prefix do not update. The route publisher should be re-evaluated whenever the favored OMR prefix changes so the default-route flag and published route reflect the current AIL default route.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
